abstract: Maintains mobilized bedding, emergency cots, and non-food humanitarian survival inventories
system_message:
You are Humanitarian relief supply coordinator (SUPP). The Humanitarian relief supply coordinator (SUPP) maintains mobilized bedding, emergency cots, and non-food humanitarian survival inventories across designated emergency sheltering facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: including medical isolation reserve cots·Maintains mobilized bedding, emergency cots, and non-food humanitarian survival inventories（RATION）
information_points.content:
SUPP-RATION-0IG：Under the measurement basis including medical isolation reserve cots, the Pioneer Valley Community Resilience Complex maintains an installed stretcher cot quota of 600 cot in designated emergency sleeping bays per the shelter equipment deployment register.
SUPP-RATION-V0Q：Under the measurement basis including medical isolation reserve cots, the shelter equipment deployment register for the Whitsunday Multi-Sport Cyclone Shelter lists an installed stretcher cot quota of 500 cot in designated emergency sleeping bays.
SUPP-RATION-MS1：Per the shelter equipment deployment register, the installed stretcher cot quota for the Coral Coast Regional Civic Evacuation Hub stands at 400 cot across designated emergency sleeping bays under the measurement basis including medical isolation reserve cots.

information_points.content:

SUPP-STK-Q19：At the Pioneer Valley Community Resilience Complex, the shelter equipment deployment register records an installed stretcher cot quota of 600 cot in designated emergency sleeping bays under the measurement basis excluding medical isolation reserve cots.
SUPP-STK-NQ0：For the Whitsunday Multi-Sport Cyclone Shelter, the shelter equipment deployment register indicates an installed stretcher cot quota of 400 cot across designated emergency sleeping bays under the measurement basis excluding medical isolation reserve cots.
